name: Network Port Range Validation
description: validate_port_number returns False instead of raising ValueError on out-of-range port numbers.
valid_search_block:
if not (1 <= port <= 65535):
        return False  # Defect: should raise ValueError(f"Invalid port: {port}")
valid_replace_block:
if not (1 <= port <= 65535):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid port: {port}")
noop_replace_block:
if not (1 <= port <= 65535):
        return False  # Defect: should raise ValueError(f"Invalid port: {port}")
